{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0701","text":"Basalt Rollout – Stakeholder Review
Thursday, 14 November, 10:00 – 11:00
Location: Boardroom, Level 3, Harborbrook History Museum (Teams link available for remote attendees)

Attendees: Nico Zapata; Sana Lindqvist; Raj Castellano; Emeka Uchenna; Fatima Abernathy; Lars Pruitt; Collections Management; Visitor Services; Digital Engagement; Facilities; Development Office

Dear colleagues,

Please join this session on the Basalt rollout. To make good use of our time, I have arranged the hour as follows:

10:00 – Welcome and context (Gemma)
10:05 – Collections Management update on catalogue record migration (Nico Zapata)
10:15 – Visitor Services update on front-of-house kiosk readiness (Sana Lindqvist)
10:25 – Digital Engagement update on the public search interface (Raj Castellano)
10:35 – Facilities update on gallery network cabling (Emeka Uchenna)
10:45 – Development Office update on donor-facing communications (Fatima Abernathy)
10:50 – Timing of the East Wing go-live and whether it proceeds ahead of the winter exhibition (Lars Pruitt)
10:58 – Close

Presenters are kindly asked to keep updates to the allotted time. Slides should be sent to me by close of business Wednesday so they can be compiled into a single deck.

If you are unable to attend, please nominate a delegate from your department and let me know in advance.

With thanks,
Gemma
